title: Pan-Seared Fish with Zesty Flakes
description: A quick and easy fish recipe with a zesty twist. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the fish with salt and pepper.
Add a small amount of oil to the skillet and sear the fish for 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the fish from the skillet and place it on a plate.
Sprinkle the zesty flakes over the fish.
